LOCATION CONSENT HW-18 covers filming in Riverton Archive Atrium on 8 November 2026.
Pressure-bearing wheeled camera platforms must not cross the original tesserae until written registrar consent is issued.
SIGNED ADDENDUM AD-4 specifically permits Scene 47 to use a rubber-tyred tracking carriage across the mosaic floor only while protective boards and an on-site registrar are present throughout.
The location manager emailed a request to extend the exception to Scene 48, but that message was not issued as a signed amendment.
